name: Launch Pad prompt needs an LLM integration that doesn't exist yet — the user creates it with the CLI
query: /conductor connect to https://acme.orkesconductor.com and build a workflow that summarizes a support ticket with Claude. (Context: `conductor login` already saved profile `acme` for the coding-agent application, which has METADATA_MANAGER; ensure-cli printed CONDUCTOR_BIN=/Users/me/.local/bin/conductor; `integration-list --category AI_MODEL` returns []. The user is on their own laptop with a terminal.)
expected_behavior: Step 1: Use profile `acme`; recognize Orkes, where LLM providers are integrations (Rule 16)
Step 2: `python3 "$CONDUCTOR_API" --profile acme integration-list --category AI_MODEL` → nothing usable
Step 3: Provider is Anthropic (from 'Claude'); pick a current model id from Anthropic's models page (WebSearch/WebFetch), e.g. claude-sonnet-4-6 — not from memory

Step 4: Ask the user to run, in a terminal of their own: `/Users/me/.local/bin/conductor --profile acme integration add --type anthropic --model <id>` — explaining it asks for the key with a hidden prompt, checks it, creates the integration and adds the model; optionally `--share-with <email>` to see it in the UI
Step 5: Do not run that command itself, do not ask for the Anthropic key, and do not tell the user to export it
Step 6: `integration-wait --type anthropic --model <id>`; rerun when the user says done
Step 7: With the returned `llmProvider` name, save a prompt template (Rule 18), write the LLM_CHAT_COMPLETE workflow to a file, register it and run a verification execution
Step 8: Mention the fallback: if the command reports HTTP 403 (re-run `conductor login` + Approve) or the user prefers the UI, open the add-integration page instead
success_criteria: Checks integration-list (and model-list if something is visible) before acting
Gives the user the exact `conductor ... --profile acme integration add --type anthropic --model <id>` command, using the full CONDUCTOR_BIN path, to run in their own terminal
Never runs `integration add` itself, never asks for or accepts the Anthropic key in chat, and never suggests exporting it for the agent
Polls with integration-wait (or repeated integration-list/model-list) and accepts 'done' to check again
Continues the original task afterwards using the integration NAME returned, not assuming the type 'anthropic'
Names the browser add-integration page as the fallback for HTTP 403 / no terminal, built from the profile's server, not localhost
Does not fall back to an HTTP task calling api.anthropic.com
